speaker: Doctor
text: Dr. Agent: I see you have a complex history; to guide my thoughts on your gait and limb ataxia, could you describe exactly when these symptoms first started and if they are worsening over time? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your vision, coordination, or sensation in your legs?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your symptoms are prominent on the right side and you feel "drunk," have you experienced any double vision, difficulty swallowing, or weakness in your arms? Also, do you have a known history of multiple sclerosis, stroke, or previous head trauma?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with and without contrast.
REQUEST IMAGES: MRI showing white matter lesions.
